claimBoundary: The kinematic axis is one formula-independent observation-coordinate nuisance, not a gravity-law fit.
The least-squares amplitude is reported as a diagnostic but discarded before every prediction.
P0750 may justify a predeclared holdout observation policy but cannot be called validation because all six targets are open.
Neither NGC2841 nor NGC7331 has any pixel array opened in this stage.
P0752 is the one-shot final holdout for the current resolved-galaxy simulator and observation policy.
One kinematic phase is an observation-coordinate nuisance shared by all formulas; its fitted speed amplitude is discarded.
The formula score on registered baryons tests the gravity law; adaptive-twin transport separately tests simulator fidelity.
No inclination, distance, M/L, Newton constant, MOND scale, pressure support, warp, dark halo, or formula-specific parameter is fitted.
A holdout miss must remain visible and cannot be repaired and relabeled as holdout evidence.
